description: Land Acquisition - Supplements 33 and 61 of Topo PP No. 17 of Thalagoda, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lot numbers, names, descriptions, extents), identifies claimants, and provides information about the acquisition process under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, specifically government acquisition of land for a public purpose development project, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification.
